back_translation: Thank you for your suggestion! We read every idea. We collect feature requests on our public roadmap via roadmap.roosterly.nl. Here you can view ideas and vote on them. Unfortunately, we cannot promise a delivery date for individual requests.
All data is stored in the EU (Frankfurt, Germany) and processed under a data processing agreement. You can download this agreement under Settings → Legal.

Employees can open the shift in the app and tap "Ruil aanbieden". Colleagues with the same role can then accept the swap. As a manager, you then approve the request under Rooster → Verzoeken. Manager approval is activated by default; you can turn off this setting if needed under Instellingen → Rooster.
You can add a new location under Settings → Locations → New location. Employees can optionally be linked to multiple locations.
